resources.string: Trip logging is off: new rides aren\'t saved (nor counted for records, trophies or maintenance).
Trip logging on — your next ride will be saved
Allow Nearby devices — Android Auto needs it to start on the dash
Turn on Bluetooth — Android Auto needs it to start on the dash
Phone Wi‑Fi is off — turn it on to connect
Can\'t find the bike\'s Wi‑Fi: switch the bike on and put the dash on interface 3, then Connect
If Android asks to connect to %1$s, tap Connect: it\'s your bike\'s Wi‑Fi
RideScreen AA connects to the bike over Wi‑Fi, and your phone\'s Wi‑Fi is off. Turn it on (you don\'t need to join any network) and Connect carries on by itself.
No location yet: allow location for RideScreen AA and turn on GPS.
Couldn\'t get the prices. Check your connection and try again.
Fuel prices are only available in Spain for now.
Gasoline 95 · within %1$d km · Ministry prices at %2$s · tap to navigate

⛽ Nearby petrol stations with the Gasolina 95 price (Spain). Sort by cheapest or closest; tap one and Maps takes you there on the dash.

📸 Park with photo: an optional button while connected. It takes a photo of where you left the bike, then disconnects and saves the spot. You can also add or see the photo later from the 🅿️ button.

❓ New Help button: installation guide, share logs, what's new and report a problem.

🔌 Easier first connection: Bluetooth permission, phone Wi‑Fi off and the bike's Wi‑Fi are explained step by step.

🧭 If trip logging is off, the trips screen tells you and lets you turn it back on.

🎞️ "Smoother" video quality is now called "Data saver (less sharp)", which is what it really does.

🛠️ Stability fixes.
Allow the camera to take the parking photo
🎯 Fit the screen to the dash (live)
Arrows on the phone, result live on the bike. Connect first to see it on the dash.
● Live: look at the bike\'s dash
Not connected: you can adjust, but connect to the bike to see it live.

The dash shows a yellow frame: that\'s where Android Auto is drawn. Move each edge with its arrows until the yellow line sits right on the visible edge of the screen, on all four sides. Hold an arrow to move faster.
Top %1$d · bottom %2$d · left %3$d · right %4$d px\nAndroid Auto area: %5$d × %6$d
Fill: no black bars, may crop a little. Whole image: nothing cropped, black bars. Stretch: fills everything, slightly distorted. Changes live.
Manual: %1$d × %2$d. Android Auto lays out its screen for this shape.
Off: Android Auto uses its standard shape.
If the map looks cropped or squashed after framing, tap \"= yellow frame\" so Android Auto draws for exactly that size. Works for vertical panels too. This one needs Android Auto to restart.
Enter a width and height (16 or more)
The new shape is applied when Android Auto restarts. Restart now? The dash goes black for a few seconds.
Saved: applied on the next connection
Resolution, orientation and the old margin pages: back in Settings → Screen & display ←
Tap to connect to the dash

To use \"Ok Google\", the intercom voice button or the watch while connected, RideScreen AA needs the microphone.\n\nPick \"While using the app\". With \"Only this time\" or \"Ask every time\" voice can stop working mid-ride.
